draft: D2 Problem: Helium leak > 2.5e-4 mbar*L/s on Inverter Housing Lot H-6104 (machined 2026-09-12). D4a Occurrence: CNC Cell-2 spindle TIR drifted to 18.4 um vs spec <= 10.0 um per active PFMEA-MACH-v3.4; operator error was ruled out. D4b Escape Point: EOL air-decay tester pressure drop threshold missed localized seal-groove chatter. D5 Action: Enable in-cycle laser probe interlock at > 8.0 um TIR and validate across 30 lots.

D2 Problem: Customer Plant-2 reported helium seal leak on EV Inverter Housings shipped last week. D4 Root Cause: Night-shift operator error — operator forgot to check CNC tool wear offset and was careless during shift handover. D5 Action: Retrain operators on SOP awareness and issue warning notice.

D2 Problem: Connector Housing flash > 0.18 mm on Lot M-4410 (2026-07-19). D4a Occurrence: Clamping pressure dropped to 135 bar vs 150 bar due to proportional valve hysteresis. D4b Escape Point: Vision check camera lighting angle missed parting-line flash. D5 Action: Calibrate valve closed-loop pressure threshold per latest October PFMEA.

D2 Problem: QFN-48 solder bridging on PCBA Batch P-8821 (reflowed 2026-08-04). D4a Occurrence: Stencil aperture paste release degraded after 12,000 prints without under-stencil wipe per PFMEA-SMT-v2.1. D4b Escape Point: 2D AOI shadow mask threshold missed corner pin bridge. D5 Action: Enforce PLC auto-lock wipe cycle every 5,000 prints and enable 3D SPI volume gate.

D2 Problem: Solder bridge found at customer ICT station; batch unknown. D4 Root Cause: Worker mistake loading stencil and no escape point documented. D5 Action: Remind operator during morning standup.

D2 Problem: Busbar weld pull force < 180 N on Module Lot B-3092 (2026-10-02). D4a Occurrence: Protective lens soot attenuation reduced focal power by 11% against PFMEA-WELD-v4.0. D4b Escape Point: Plasma photodiode sensor threshold lacked low-energy drift bound. D5 Action: Add automated power-meter interlock before every 200 welds.

D2 Problem: Weak busbar weld reported on returned modules; lot unspecified. D4 Root Cause: Inattentive technician missed lens cleaning schedule; unpinned PFMEA; without escape point check. D5 Action: Retrain technician on cleaning log.

D2 Problem: M6 cover bolt preload loss on Sub-Assy Lot F-1190 (2026-09-21). D4a Occurrence: Blind-hole tapping chip residue caused premature torque peak at 11 deg seating angle under PFMEA-ASSY-v1.8. D4b Escape Point: Nutrunner controller checked peak torque only without minimum seating-angle window. D5 Action: Program PLC nutrunner angle-window interlock (15-28 deg) with auto-lock on NOK.
D2 Problem: Loose M6 bolt on housing. D4 Root Cause: Careless operator cross-threaded bolt during manual start. D5 Action: Issue warning notice and retrain assembly line staff.

D2 Problem: Bearing journal OD ovality 9.2 um on Batch G-5508 (2026-06-15). D4a Occurrence: Dress diamond wear induced wheel lobing under PFMEA-GRIND-v3.2. D4b Escape Point: Two-point snap gauge missed 3-lobe roundness error. D5 Action: Install automated air-spindle harmonic monitor interlock and 3-point in-process gauge.
D2 Problem: Shaft ovality out of tolerance; no lot recorded. D4 Root Cause: Human error reading micrometer and missing detection gap review. D5 Action: Awareness training for grinding cell.

D2 Problem: Bore concentricity 0.045 mm vs <= 0.025 mm on Lot MP-774 (2026-08-29). D4a Occurrence: Cavity insert thermal expansion imbalance from clogged baffle channel B2 per PFMEA-MOLD-v5.1. D4b Escape Point: Sampling CMM inspected 1 cavity per shift instead of all 4 cavities. D5 Action: Add ultrasonic flow-meter PLC interlock on each cooling circuit and cavity-indexed CMM gate.

D2 Problem: Bore concentricity drift on Lot MP-774 (2026-08-29). D4a Occurrence: Cooling baffle B2 flow dropped 40% per PFMEA-MOLD-v5.1. D4b Escape Point: No escape point evaluated yet. D5 Action: Add ultrasonic flow-meter PLC interlock on mold manifold.

D2 Problem: Enamel insulation micro-crack hi-pot trip on Batch S-2041 (2026-10-11). D4a Occurrence: Bending die radius galling raised friction coefficient under PFMEA-STAT-v2.3. D4b Escape Point: Inline camera checked pin height only; partial-discharge tester threshold set at 25 pC instead of 10 pC. D5 Action: Tighten automated PD tester threshold to 10 pC and add die-stroke counter interlock.
D2 Problem: Stator hi-pot failure at customer EOL; lot TBD. D4 Root Cause: Operator forgot die lubrication; PFMEA N/A; escape point unknown. D5 Action: Remind operator every shift.

D2 Problem: Brinell hardness 78 HB vs >= 90 HB on Heat A-6612 (2026-07-08). D4a Occurrence: Quench tank agitation impeller VFD fault delayed transfer quench rate per PFMEA-HT-v1.4. D4b Escape Point: Furnace chart logged air zone temp but lacked VFD current alarm; coupon tested top basket only. D5 Action: Wire VFD current-drop PLC interlock to abort cycle and mandate top/bottom basket check.

D2 Problem: Low hardness on Heat A-6612 (2026-07-08). D4a Occurrence: Quench agitation VFD tripped during transfer. D4b Escape Point: Furnace gauge lacked agitation current monitor. D5 Action: Wire VFD current PLC interlock per latest PFMEA.

D2 Problem: Salt-spray pitting at 96 hrs on Lot AN-903 (2026-09-03). D4a Occurrence: Deionized rinse conductivity rose to 48 uS/cm before seal bath under PFMEA-SURF-v2.0. D4b Escape Point: Eddy-current film thickness gauge cannot detect unsealed pore contamination. D5 Action: Install inline conductivity probe PLC auto-lock at > 15 uS/cm.

D2 Problem: Coplanarity > 0.05 mm on Reel Lot LF-418 (2026-10-18). D4a Occurrence: Stripper plate spring fatigue caused uneven release force per PFMEA-STAMP-v3.0; human error was ruled out via setup log. D4b Escape Point: 2D profile projector missed Z-axis twist on corner leads. D5 Action: Add laser coplanarity vision check interlock on reel winder.

D2 Problem: Bent leads reported by OSAT assembly house. D4 Root Cause: Night-shift operator careless handling reel unloading and without detection check. D5 Action: Retrain night-shift operator on handling awareness.
